# Foreword

This textbook gathers the labs (problems and programming exercises) of the course "Basics of image processing"
of the [master IRIV](https://www.master-iriv.fr/) program at the [University of Strasbourg](https://www.unistra.fr/).
The programming exercises need Python which is free and now used by many communities (medicine, astronomy, biology...).
To do the exercises on your own computer, you must install Python and Jupyter Lab, as explained on the page [](python).
This course comes with [this Moodle page](https://moodle.unistra.fr/course/view.php?id=6678) (accessible only to my students).
